articles.title: Kane receives his second Golden Boot... with his sights set on a record only for the chosen few
articles.standfirst: Bayern's striker received the trophy as the top scorer in the European leagues in 25-26
articles.summary: Bayern's striker received the trophy as the top scorer in the European leagues in 25-26
articles.body:
Harry Kane received the Golden Shoe this afternoon in Munich, recognizing him as the top scorer in the European leagues in the 2025-26 season thanks to his 36 goals in 31 Bundesliga matches with league champions Bayern.

The ceremony took place in the club’s Museum , located at the Allianz Arena. The English striker was accompanied by Christian Dreesen (Bayern CEO), Marc Lenz (Bundesliga President), Luca Toni (Golden Shoe winner and ESM representative) , which sponsors the award.

"I want to thank Bayern, the staff, the coaches, and my teammates . Without them, I wouldn't be here. There is a lot of work behind an award like this," said Kane . "I try to help the team in the best way possible. Last season was exceptional, and I am very proud. It was the best season of my career so far. I feel very comfortable at Bayern and with the team. We always aim for big things, and we want to do it again this season".

It is the second Golden Boot that HK will receive, after the one won in 2023-24, when he was already at Bayern in Germany. Harry, at 33 years of age, expressed his desire to go for a third, which would place him on the podium of a trio of truly chosen ones, since only two footballers in the history of this award have managed more than two trophies... and they could be none other than Lionel Messi (six awards) and Cristiano Ronaldo (four Golden Boots). Then there are another 11 footballers (Kane among them) with two.

The Golden Shoe is an objective award, without any kind of outside opinion, presented by ESM (European Sport Media), of which MARCA is the Spanish member, among some of Europe's most prestigious media outlets . Since 96-97, the Golden Shoe has awarded two points for each goal scored in the major European leagues, reflecting the difficulty they pose compared with other leagues in which each goal is valued at 1.5 or even just one point.

In the 25-26 season, Harry, with those 36 goals, finished first ahead of the goals scored by Erling Halaand (26 with City) and Kylian Mbappé (25 with Real Madrid), who won the Silver Boot and the Bronze Boot, respectively.

articles.title: Michael Olise is becoming Bayern Munich’s new Champions League star
articles.standfirst: The scary part is that the French attacker is entering the prime of his career
articles.summary: The scary part is that the French attacker is entering the prime of his career
articles.body:
B ayern Munich have no shortage of world-class talent, but few players are generating as much excitement heading into the heart of the 2026-27 season as Michael Olise.

The French winger has carried over the sensational form that made him one of Bayern’s most important players last year, and his recent performances are creating growing buzz around Europe. With the Champions League once again underway, Olise looks increasingly capable of becoming one of the competition’s defining stars.

At just 24 years old, the Bayern attacker is entering the prime of his career, and the early signs suggest he is ready to elevate his game even further.

A trophy-winning start to the season

Olise wasted little time making an impact after the summer break. The winger played a central role in Bayern Munich's first trophy of the new campaign, helping the German giants defeat Borussia Dortmund 2-1 in the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup. Olise scored once and added an assist in a Man of the Match performance that reminded fans why he was voted Bayern's Player of the Season just a few months earlier.

He followed that display with another goal in Bayern's 5-1 Bundesliga victory over VfB Stuttgart, continuing a run of form that has become increasingly difficult for opposing defenses to contain. In just two competitive matches during August, Olise recorded two goals and one assist, helping Bayern begin the season exactly as expected: winning. Munich fans are taking notice

The numbers tell part of the story, but Bayern supporters have clearly noticed something bigger. After winning the club's Goal of the Month award, Olise added another honor when fans voted him FC Bayern's August 2026 Player of the Month. He captured 43.8 percent of the vote, finishing comfortably ahead of summer signing Nathaniel Brown and Colombian star Luis Díaz.

The growing influence Olise has

Winning fan awards at Bayern Munich is never easy given the caliber of talent competing for attention. Yet Olise continues to stand out thanks to his creativity, directness and ability to produce decisive moments in important matches.

Olise's development is becoming one of Europe's most intriguing storylines. His combination of technical skill, vision and explosiveness makes him a nightmare matchup in one-on-one situations. Defenders who attempt to give him space risk being punished by his passing ability, while those who close aggressively often find themselves beaten off the dribble.

Elite attackers are ultimately judged by goals and assists, and Olise is delivering both at an increasingly consistent rate. That evolution is particularly important in the Champions League, where knockout-round matches are often decided by a handful of moments. Bayern already possess one of Europe's deepest squads . Adding a fully confident and in-form Olise to that equation only increases their threat level.
